summary: Backend-only regression on the 4 critical fixes (BankEzee CRM). Ran 16 pytest tests (all passing). Verified: (1) /attendance/admin/summary + /admin/today return IST-based date/boundaries (server_time_ist present, date param respected). (2) /api/leads?search= supports case-insensitive partial match on name, email, phone; normalized phone lookup with +91 country-code prefix works. (3) New /api/call-logs/mobile creates unified call_logs doc with source='mobile', is_verified=true, updates lead.last_call_* and last_verified_call_* fields, increments daily_session stats (calls_made, total_call_seconds). (4) New /api/call-logs/unified returns combined web+mobile logs with source and is_verified fields; source filter works. Access control (403 for lead not assigned to agent) enforced.

minor.issue: Legacy call_logs without an is_verified field are inferred as verified only when source=='mobile'. This is fine going forward, but historical web logs will all show is_verified=false even if they were verified via a device-sync match. Consider joining with verified_call_logs collection when computing is_verified.

verified_talk_time_seconds is incremented via $inc for every mobile call, but the /call-logs/sync endpoint recomputes and $set the same field from verified_call_logs. If a mobile call is later also detected in device sync, verified_talk_time_seconds may drift (double-count then be overwritten). Consider consolidating the source of truth.

Normalized phone regex uses substring match, so searching '9876' will also match a phone '19876543' (unlikely for Indian 10-digit numbers, but not strictly last-10-digits). Consider anchoring or matching phone.endsWith(normalized_search).

action_items: (Optional) Improve is_verified logic for legacy web call logs in /call-logs/unified by cross-referencing verified_call_logs.
(Optional) Anchor normalized phone regex to end-of-string to avoid false positive matches.
React Native Mobile Post-Call Modal auto-trigger was NOT tested (frontend RN code, out of scope for API tests) - main agent should manually verify on-device.
critical_code_review_comments: calls.py is ~645 lines and grows with new unified endpoints; consider splitting into call_sessions.py, call_logs.py, mobile_calls.py.

attendance.py get_user_work_mode still checks wfh_approvals with status='APPROVED' - the previously reported bug (iteration_12) about admin_assign_wfh not setting status='APPROVED' is not part of the current fix scope but remains open; re-verify after fix.
In /call-logs/mobile, device_timestamp is not validated for future dates; a malicious client could report calls in the future.
In leads search, phone normalization strips '+' and country codes but keeps substring match - could unintentionally match unrelated numbers if they share the trailing digits substring.
MobileCallLogCreate has no validation on duration_seconds (accepts negative).
